D1.evidenceQuote: the BTC/USD closing price on Coinbase
D1.reasoning: The outcome is large-scale market data that no identifiable party controls.

D2.reasoning: The settlement value is public the instant it exists; there is no early-knowledge window.

D3.reasoning: No early-knowledge window exists (D2 level 1), so there is no insider to constrain.

D4.reasoning: Everyone observes the closing price at the same fixed moment.

D5.reasoning: Moving the global bitcoin price across a strike would cost far more than any plausible stake could recover.
